# The Last Bell

At noon the bell swings without a voice. Beyond the breakwater the fishing
fleet is preparing to leave. Ivo bars the tower door and blames Mara's repairs.
A service hatch on the public quay offers a way to investigate his accusation.

The Story asks whether people can repair a warning system without first
agreeing who deserved the blame. Win access through an appeal or tangible evidence,
recover the clapper with the sounding magnet or the drain lever, and decide whether
to ask Ivo for an account or leave him behind. The logbook investigation is optional.
Both endings save the fleet; only one begins to repair trust.

Read the Puzzle records for attempts, feedback and hints, and Authored Content for
playable descriptions and dialogue. Named Narrative Positions expose derived state
before, during and after the tower exchange. The catalog validates declared logic,
not engine playability or literary quality. All creative choices remain delegated
agent-origin examples. This reference validates the experimental contract; it does
not authorize a production freeze or add to the normative twelve-skill inventory.
